title: Stephen Hahn request concerning Philadelphia Metro West Presbytery
disposition_detail: The SJC found the request for the SJC to assume original jurisdiction over Philadelphia Metro West Presbytery administratively out of order; no merits review followed.
first_summary: Mr. Stephen Hahn asked the Standing Judicial Commission to assume original jurisdiction over Philadelphia Metro West Presbytery. The SJC found the request administratively out of order and therefore did not reach the merits. The record gives no reason for that ruling.
